volume_mesh_flag_doc:
Type: bool                                                              
   Default: True                                                           
   
   If True then generate a volume mesh.
surface_mesh_flag_doc:
Type: bool                                                              
   Default: True                                                           
   
   If True then perform surface remeshing.
no_bisect_doc:
Type: bool                                                              
   Default: True                                                           
   If True then use the solid model surface mesh for the volume mesh.
set_walls_doc:
set_walls(face_ids)  
   
   Set the given faces to be of type wall. 
   
   This function must be called prior to meshing to identify model wall     
   and cap faces.                                                           
   
   A solid model must be loaded before calling this function. The solid     
   model must have boundary faces defined for it.                           
   
   Args: 
     face_ids (list[int]): The face IDs to set to type wall.
